scientific_integrity: An elementary valuation and shortest-border proof establishes all exponents; finite direct-optimization checks are diagnostics, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for dyadic prefixes of the binary period-doubling word; no claim for arbitrary factors or arbitrary prefix lengths. Bibliographic search cannot eliminate all unindexed equivalents.
title: Dyadic block-palindrome widths of the period-doubling word
